device.title: Approve a CLI login
device.subtitle: heimdall login on another machine printed a code. Check it matches, then approve.
device.notFound: No login is waiting for this code
device.notFoundBody: It expired or was mistyped. Run heimdall login again for a new code.

scopes.read: Read only: agents, benchmarks, report cards

device.warning: Only approve a code you started yourself. The device gets an API token for this organization.
device.approvedBody: The terminal is logged in to {{org}}. Revoke the token any time under Settings > API tokens.
device.deniedBody: The terminal was told no. Nothing was created.
device.localBody: This is a local server: the CLI uses its write token. Run: echo "$BENCH_WRITE_TOKEN" | heimdall login -with-token

ide.desc: Connect agents from Cursor, Claude Code or VS Code through the Heimdall MCP server.
ide.title: Connect from your editor
ide.subtitle: The Heimdall MCP server runs on your machine, reads the workspace your editor has open and uses your heimdall login. Your editor's agent can then connect an agent, check it and run a first look.
ide.step1: Install the heimdall binary and log in once:
ide.step2: Add the server to your editor:
ide.noSecret: No token is in these links or commands: the MCP server reads the one heimdall login stored.
ide.tools: Tools it adds: connect_agent, verify_agent, first_look, and the evaluation and report card tools.
